projects.title: MLflow Experiment Tracking
bullets: Set up MLflow experiment tracking across a 211-file project, logging model runs during a machine-learning operations training program.

projects.title: MLOps Monitoring with Grafana and Evidently
bullets: Built a monitoring pipeline with Evidently and Grafana in Docker to track model drift, connecting metrics to a PostgreSQL backend.
Containerized the monitoring stack with Docker so metrics dashboards could run independent of the training environment.

projects.title: MLOps Batch Deployment
bullets: Packaged a batch-scoring pipeline with Pipenv and Docker, using pandas and scikit-learn to structure the deployment workflow.

leadership.title: Cohort Participant
bullets: After scraped review data for a sentiment-analysis side project came in inconsistent formats, learned why reliable pipelines mattered more than model choice.
Maintained a shared troubleshooting log for cohort peers working through the same deployment exercises, cutting down repeated setup questions.
